generated_modules.form: One initialize function per module over hsm_documents::interop::Val; Python names resolve at run time through Env scopes; modules outside the compiled set import through the Python adapter callback

bazel_step_durations.basis: Profile durations of full builds on the shared host; not matched runs

matched_steps.method: Genrule work directory rebuilt from the revision's sources and committed generated inputs; generator run directly; CPU is user plus system of the generator and its waited Rust workers; median of three warm runs

compile.command: cargo build --release -j2 -p <crate>, private target, deps already built

opt_level_runtime.method: Same staged work directory; only the named workers' binaries differ; alternating warm runs, median of three

enclosure-assembly.worker_method: ps samples of each worker every half second through one run

output_identity.method: SHA-256 of every file the staged step leaves, opt-level 3 workers against opt-level 0 workers
